question: Identify the correct match in the context of microfinance.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Muhammad Yunus - Grameen Bank - Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Yunus** is a renowned Bangladeshi social entrepreneur, economist, and the founder of the **Grameen Bank**.
 
• The **Grameen Bank** is a microfinance organization and community development bank based in **Bangladesh**.
 
• It provides **small loans** (microcredit) to impoverished individuals without requiring collateral, primarily targeting **women** and rural communities.
 
• **Muhammad Yunus** is widely known as the "Father of Microfinance" for his efforts in pioneering the concept of microcredit.
 
• He was awarded the **Nobel Peace Prize in 2006**, along with the Grameen Bank, for their role in economic and social development.
 
• The success of the Grameen Bank has inspired similar microfinance initiatives globally, aiming to **eradicate poverty** and foster financial inclusion.
 
• The bank operates on principles of **trust, solidarity, and collective responsibility**, empowering borrowers to improve their lives through entrepreneurship and self-sufficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Yasir - Grameen Bank - Bangladesh**__

 __
 
• **Muhammad Yasir** is not associated with the **Grameen Bank** or microfinance. This option is factually incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Muhammad Yasir - Grameen Bank - Pakistan**__
 __
 
• **Muhammad Yasir** has no connection to microfinance or the **Grameen Bank**. Additionally, the **Grameen Bank** is based in **Bangladesh**, not **Pakistan**.
 
 
 
• **Muhammad Yunus - Grameen Bank - Pakistan**__
 
 
• **Muhammad Yunus** is associated with the **Grameen Bank**, but the bank is located in **Bangladesh**, not **Pakistan**.
